entities.name: Damascus Steel
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: A legendary type of steel used in swords and blades from the Near East, characterized by distinctive wavy patterns (watered steel) and exceptional sharpness and durability. Produced using wootz crucible steel from India, Damascus blades were prized throughout the medieval world and their metallurgical secrets — involving carbon nanotubes — were only recently understood by modern science.
